items.caseName: Pinarayi Vijayan v. Adv. K.M. Shajahan
items.headline: Probe against ex-Kerala CM paused for 7 days
items.text: HC's refusal of leave set aside; Vijayan and kin may appeal the FIR direction in the CMRL-Exalogic case. Probe stayed 7 days.
items.why: The Court noted S.175(4) BNSS gives public servants safeguards that S.156(3) CrPC lacked, and told ED not to step on the State agency's probe.

items.caseName: Yuvajana Sramika Rythu Congress Party v. State of Andhra Pradesh & Ors.
items.headline: Courts can step in when polls are hit by illegal means
items.text: AP Election Commission told to decide on extending municipal nomination deadline and defer the final candidate list; police protection ordered.

items.caseName: Rakesh Kumar Mishra v. State of U.P. & 4 Ors.
items.coram: Alok Mathur, Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, JJ.
items.headline: Power connection can't be denied over a property dispute
items.text: Electricity is part of the Article 21 right to life; a pending civil title dispute alone can't bar a connection if the indemnity form is given.

items.caseName: State Bank of India v. P. Rama Chandraiah & Ors.
items.headline: Flawed caste-certificate inquiry goes back, not quashed
items.text: Where natural justice is breached, the scrutiny committee should redo the inquiry from that point; SC certificate case remanded for 3 months.

items.caseName: Thota Gopal & Ors. v. Pandipati Gopal Reddy & Ors.
items.headline: Backdated sale deals may draw perjury prosecution
items.text: Two backdated sale agreements were found fabricated (S.193 IPC); a sale made in breach of an undertaking may attract S.206 IPC.

items.caseName: State of Maharashtra v. UIDAI & Ors.
items.headline: UIDAI must hand ATS papers behind suspect's Aadhaar
items.text: UIDAI to produce the documents within 2 weeks; those helping foreigners get Aadhaar, PAN or voter IDs should be probed and prosecuted.

items.caseName: Nagendra Kanojiya v. CEO, SRA & Ors.
items.headline: Fines for secretly filming a court hearing
items.text: Junior advocate fined ₹25,000 and clerk ₹10,000 for recording proceedings on a phone; recording deleted, undertakings taken.

items.caseName: Lokesh Sinha v. Smt. Kusumlata Sinha & Anr.
items.coram: Parth Prateem Sahu, Sushma Sawant, JJ.
items.headline: 498A acquittal doesn't prove cruelty claims false
items.text: Husband's divorce appeal dismissed; acquittal in the criminal case alone doesn't show the wife's cruelty allegations were false.

items.caseName: Saurav Das & Anr. v. State (NCT of Delhi)
items.headline: CJP leaders withdraw custody challenge
items.text: Plea against extension of judicial custody allowed to be withdrawn, with liberty to use BNSS remedies; no view on merits.
items.why: Later the same day the Special Executive Magistrate released both on bonds (Bar & Bench).

items.caseName: Union of India & Anr. v. Om Prakash
items.coram: C. Hari Shankar, Vinod Kumar, JJ.
items.headline: Only SC can bar its rulings from being cited
items.text: A 'not to be cited as precedent' caveat is unique to the Supreme Court; CAT order for a retired MoEFCC scientist upheld.

items.caseName: Rajat Kumar v. UT of J&K
items.headline: Absconding accused can't ordinarily get pre-arrest bail
items.text: Rape accused declared proclaimed offender denied anticipatory bail; no exceptional reason shown to skip the Sessions Court.

items.caseName: Raj Sharma (Bharti) v. Collector Land Acquisition & Anr.
items.headline: Collector must deliver land promised under award
items.text: If exchange land is occupied, the Collector must give equivalent alternate land; 4 kanals to be handed over in 3 months.

items.caseName: Sheeri Pal Singh v. CBI
items.headline: Sanction stands even if offence isn't named
items.text: Not naming the exact offence doesn't void a sanction if the material shows its ingredients; plea to quash S.4-H charge dismissed.

items.caseName: Pankaj Kumar Yadav v. State of Jharkhand & Ors.
items.coram: M.S. Sonak, CJ, Manoj Prasad, J.
items.headline: Finish bridge-collapse probes pending since 2009
items.text: Police in Dhanbad, Palamau and Gumla told to file final reports, ideally in 3 months; plea to remove engineer-in-chief rejected.

items.caseName: Lalgarh Welfare Society v. State of Jharkhand
items.coram: M.S. Sonak, CJ, Manoj Prasad, J.
items.headline: Court won't second-guess railway experts
items.text: No order for a road over-bridge; Railways to finish the subway in 4 months and fix flooding so children can cross safely.

items.caseName: Tata AIG v. Prabha Kumari & Ors.
items.headline: Some overtime counts in accident compensation
items.text: Limited overtime can be added to a deceased guard's income even if pay slips show none; award raised to ₹35.37 lakh.

items.caseName: Allabhaksha M. Makandar v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Dealer not liable for bad fertiliser in sealed bags
items.text: FIR under the Essential Commodities Act quashed; a mere dealer can't be blamed for the quality of sealed products.

items.caseName: Mahantesh Angadi v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Parole extension can't be refused without reasons
items.text: Unreasoned rejection of a murder convict's 30-day parole extension quashed; DG Prisons to decide afresh in 15 days.

items.caseName: Kallappa v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Bail for journalist accused of posing as a cop
items.text: Regular bail granted as recovery is complete and custody no longer needed; ₹2 lakh bond and fortnightly reporting.

items.caseName: Praful Balakrishna Patil v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Pre-arrest bail in attempt-to-murder case
items.text: No reasonable prima facie ground to believe guilt at this stage; anticipatory bail on ₹1 lakh bond and weekly reporting.

items.caseName: DB v. State of M.P.
items.headline: No prior dowry deal needed to prosecute
items.text: A dowry demand after marriage is punishable too; husband's 498A IPC and S.4 Dowry Act conviction restored.

items.caseName: SC v. SAC
items.headline: Grandmother can seek maintenance for minor
items.text: A maternal grandmother need not first be appointed guardian to claim S.125 CrPC maintenance for a minor; matter remanded.

items.caseName: Karpuri Thakur v. State of Bihar
items.headline: Witness can't be believed only in part
items.text: Conviction under Ss.304/34 IPC set aside; prosecution can't rely on one part of a witness's account and ignore the rest.

items.caseName: Rahul Kumar Gautam v. Punjab National Bank & Ors.
items.headline: Unproved expert report can't sustain dismissal
items.text: PNB clerk's dismissal for exam impersonation quashed; the handwriting expert was never examined to prove his report.

items.caseName: Chander Bhushan v. State of Rajasthan & Anr.
items.headline: India-US treaty used to trace rape complainant
items.text: Under the MLAT and S.110 BNSS, MHA asked to locate and serve a complainant in the US, unserved for about 2 years.

items.caseName: State of Rajasthan & Ors. v. Dr. Rupendra Kumar Sharma
items.headline: Late charge sheet doesn't void suspension
items.text: Not serving a charge sheet in 3 months doesn't make suspension illegal by itself; medical officer's suspension restored.

items.caseName: LRs of Late Shri Chandra Narayan Mathur v. State of Rajasthan & Ors.
items.headline: Retired judge's transplant claim to be paid
items.text: Law Secretary couldn't review committee approvals; claim to be paid in a month with 12% interest and ₹50,000 costs.

items.caseName: S v. State of Rajasthan & Ors.
items.headline: Child maintenance claim survives mother's death
items.text: Grandmother may continue the maintenance case; father's custody proceedings don't end the children's claim.

items.caseName: United India Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Phoola Bai & Ors.
items.headline: Insurer's top manager summoned over lax defence
items.text: Chief Regional Manager to explain by affidavit how claims are monitored and lawyers assigned; ₹5 lakh award stayed.

items.caseName: Pooja Yadav v. State of Rajasthan & Ors.
items.headline: 180-day maternity leave for teacher
items.text: Teacher who joined a new school after childbirth gets full maternity leave with pay; child care leave used to be credited back.

items.caseName: Vinod Agarwal v. State of Rajasthan & Ors.
items.headline: Narrow review of transfer orders
items.text: Courts interfere only for malice, illegality or extreme hardship; employees may file representations, transfers stayed 4 weeks.

items.caseName: B.R. Ramakrishna v. Union of India

items.caseName: Hanumanthappa v. Shanthamma & Ors.
items.headline: Daughter of void marriage inherits father's share

items.caseName: Remadevi T.L. v. Reserve Bank of India & Ors.
items.headline: SBI must refund ₹3.73 lakh to fraud victim

items.caseName: Ravi E. & Anr. v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.headline: No extension of SC deadline for temple elephants
items.text: Neither the State nor the HC can extend the 2015 Supreme Court deadline to register captive elephants.

items.headline: Clear ₹9.73 crore victim compensation in five weeks
items.text: State told to release funds for 225 pending claims and KeLSA to speed payouts; listed on 2 December.

items.text: Interim protection in the SC/ST case filed by the ACP against her; Court mooted a women-led panel on assault complaints.

items.caseName: Democratic Medical Association v. Union of India
items.headline: Notice on NEET-PG 2026 answer-disclosure plea
items.text: Plea seeks release of NEET-PG 2026 questions, options and answers; tagged with pending exam pleas.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, J.
items.headline: Rajpal Yadav cheque case sent to mediation
items.text: Dispute sent to a sole mediator after ₹2 cr deposit; trial court to release the actor's passport on conditions.

items.caseName: Dashrath Yadav v. State of Uttar Pradesh
items.headline: UP panchayat polls within 3 months, with 27% OBC quota
items.text: SEC to hold village polls under existing reservation; the commission's pending inquiry cannot delay them.

items.caseName: X & Y v. State of U.P.
items.headline: No regular FIR against juveniles for serious offences
items.text: FIR, chargesheet and JJB case against two minors quashed for breach of Rule 8, JJ Model Rules; fresh action allowed.

items.caseName: A v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Marriage made in ignorance of POCSO need not be broken
items.text: Now-adult prosecutrix may live with the accused husband; Law Commission asked to weigh POCSO sentencing discretion.

items.caseName: Royal Sundaram Alliance Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Purama Raghavamma
items.headline: Insurer liable even if policy not moved to new owner
items.text: Under S.157(1) MV Act, a policy in force is deemed transferred with the vehicle; insurer's appeal dismissed.

items.caseName: High Court on Its Own Motion v. State of Maharashtra
items.coram: Girish S. Kulkarni, Neela K. Gokhale, JJ.
items.headline: Street firecracker ban applies to all festivals
items.text: Ban on bursting crackers on streets extended year-round; sale not banned. State and BMC to set up a complaint system.

items.caseName: Kiran Tukaram Shelke v. Union of India
items.coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, CJ, Advait M. Sethna, J.
items.headline: Rail pass denial to children of void marriages quashed
items.text: Railway Board's 2005 circular struck down under Art. 14; claims to be reconsidered within 2 months.

items.caseName: Tata Capital Housing Finance Ltd. v. Heera Construction Co. Pvt. Ltd.
items.headline: Litigant pulled up for joining VC unclothed in bed
items.text: Conduct deprecated; asset-disclosure affidavit due 21 Oct and personal appearance ordered. Listed 26 Oct.

items.caseName: Amalaksha Jana v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Art college principal's appointment quashed
items.text: Quo warranto issued: the State cannot create an 'eminent artist' route outside UGC norms.

items.caseName: Malay Ghosh v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Life term upheld for couple in girl's murder
items.text: Complete chain of circumstances proved the 2011 murder of a 6-year-old and hiding of her body; appeal dismissed.

items.caseName: Communist Party of India (Marxist) v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: CPI(M) may set up Puja book stall at Bongaon
items.text: Stall allowed near its office after objections; police to keep the peace and SP to file a report.

items.caseName: Tanushree Sarkar @ Putul v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Bangladeshi woman's term cut to time served
items.text: Foreigners Act conviction upheld but sentence cut to ~1.5 years served; release and repatriation ordered.

items.caseName: Sanjay Ghosh v. High Court at Calcutta
items.coram: Ravindra V. Ghuge, CJ, Om Narayan Rai, J.
items.headline: No masjid on HC rooftop; advocate to explain keys
items.text: Advocate impleaded to explain holding the room's keys; custody referred to Security Committee. Listed 14 Dec.

items.caseName: Rajender Kumar Dudeja v. High Court at Calcutta
items.coram: Ravindra V. Ghuge, CJ, Om Narayan Rai, J.
items.headline: Ex-judicial officer warned of aggravated contempt
items.text: Appeal dismissed and apology accepted; similar language in future may invite aggravated contempt.

items.caseName: ANSXXX & Anr. v. State of NCT of Delhi & Anr.
items.headline: Women can be charged with gang rape
items.text: A woman can face S.376D IPC / S.70 BNS charges without herself committing the act; charge order upheld.

items.caseName: Government of NCT of Delhi v. National Human Rights Commission
items.headline: Police-station death alone isn't proof of negligence
items.text: NHRC's ₹5 lakh award over a 2019 suicide set aside; no evidence of specific police negligence.

items.caseName: Manish Grover v. State Govt. of NCT of Delhi
items.coram: Nitin Wasudeo Sambre, ACJ, Sanjay Sharma, J.
items.headline: Officials to answer for building near protected monument
items.text: ASI, MCD and police officials to file personal affidavits in 2 weeks naming those at fault. Listed 28 Oct.

items.caseName: Anil Kumar Gupta v. Union of India
items.coram: Nitin Wasudeo Sambre, ACJ, Sanjay Sharma, J.
items.headline: Police assurance recorded on Connaught Place protest
items.text: Delhi Police assured steps over the planned 16 Oct protest; no specific restraint order. Listed 3 Nov.

items.caseName: Prashant Sudarshan Arkal v. Union of India
items.headline: No change to finalised Asian Para Games squad
items.text: Para-cyclists' plea dismissed; courts won't alter a final contingent unless selection was arbitrary.

items.caseName: Umehabbebiba Quadri v. Jamia Millia Islamia
items.headline: Jamia to consider hostel for student
items.text: 55% eligibility rule upheld, but Jamia to treat the plea as a representation and decide in 7 days.

items.caseName: Mehul Mansukhbhai Boghara v. State of Gujarat
items.headline: FIR against lawyer-activist quashed as counterblast
items.text: Filming public servants on duty isn't criminal force; extortion and SC/ST charges found vague.

items.caseName: Suo Motu v. Deepak Khosla
items.coram: N.S. Sanjay Gowda, J.L. Odedra, JJ.
items.headline: Contempt against lawyer closed after apology
items.text: Criminal contempt over remarks on sitting judges closed after an apology and ₹1 lakh donation.

items.caseName: X v. Union Territory of J&K
items.headline: Medical board ordered for 32-week termination
items.text: Hospital told to form a board on the abnormal foetus; HC flagged doctors shirking MTP Act duties.

items.caseName: Prof. S.K. Bhalla v. Union Territory of J&K
items.coram: Pushpendra Singh Bhati, CJ, Rajesh Sekhri, J.
items.headline: HC questions govt housing for Azad, Raina
items.text: UT to explain the policy letting political figures keep government homes. Listed 12 Nov.

items.caseName: PN v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Child welfare over foreign return order
items.text: Father's habeas plea to take daughter to Canada dismissed; custody left to the Indian court.

items.caseName: B v. A
items.coram: D.K. Singh, H. Shanthi Bhushan, JJ.
items.headline: Remarriage cuts, but doesn't bar, alimony
items.text: Permanent alimony cut from ₹25 lakh to ₹10 lakh after the wife remarried.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.headline: Unpaid maintenance no ground to deny visits
items.text: Father's access widened to 3 days a month, school events and 10 summer days.

items.caseName: Zainul Abdeen v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Cow slaughter case quashed: raid before FIR
items.text: Police searched and seized before registering an FIR, vitiating the case.

items.caseName: President, Shri Vishnumurthy Temple Kalenja v. Commissioner, Endowments
items.coram: Vibhu Bakhru, CJ, K.S. Hemalekha, J.
items.headline: Delegated temple inquiry can't be sub-delegated
items.text: S.43(6) enquiry by a sub-delegate set aside; matter remitted for fresh enquiry.

items.caseName: Vivek M. Narayan v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Partition suit doesn't make complaints false
items.text: Plea to quash an assault case by an uncle refused; trial to go on.

items.caseName: Satteppa v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: Pre-arrest bail denied to advocate in rape case
items.text: Serious allegations of rape and caste abuse need investigation.

items.caseName: Arala Damodar Prabhu v. State
items.headline: ₹15,000 costs over 'God can't appear' argument
items.text: Plea to quash cheating case dismissed; costs for counsel's argument.

items.caseName: Pinarayi Vijayan v. K.M. Shajahan
items.headline: No relief to Pinarayi in CMRL-Exalogic case
items.text: Leave to appeal refused against direction for a Vigilance FIR; ED material enough without preliminary inquiry.

items.caseName: Tomin J. Thachankary v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Ex-DGP's 4-year DA sentence suspended
items.text: Suspended pending appeal on deposit of 75% of the ₹30.84 lakh fine and a ₹5 lakh bond.

items.caseName: State of Kerala v. Government of India
items.headline: UIDAI to match suspects' prints in murder probe
items.text: UIDAI to check suspects' fingerprints and report locations; Aadhaar curbs don't cover location-only data.

items.caseName: S v. J
items.headline: Remarriage no ground to cut child's maintenance
items.text: Father's second family can't reduce support for the first child; ₹15,000 a month upheld.

items.caseName: Roddam Pandurangaiah Naga Govardhan v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Sabarimala gold theft accused can't travel abroad
items.text: Plea to visit Australia for daughter's graduation refused; passport surrender was a bail term.

items.caseName: Prasanth K. v. District Collector
items.headline: Permanent fireworks shop rules don't bind temporary ones
items.text: 2008 amendments to Rules 83, 86 don't apply to Rule 84 temporary licences; to be decided afresh.

items.caseName: Suo Motu v. Chief Secretary
items.coram: Raja Vijayaraghavan V., K.V. Jayakumar, JJ.
items.headline: State told to act on speeding after fatal crash
items.text: Road-safety case: AI-camera speeding data, action taken and committee status sought.

items.caseName: Preeti Sharma v. State of Madhya Pradesh
items.headline: Electricity is part of the right to life
items.text: Supply to be restored to the occupier in 7 days despite a property dispute.

items.caseName: Ramnath Mishra v. Special Police Establishment
items.coram: Subodh Abhyankar, Jai Kumar Pillai, JJ.
items.headline: Sanctioning authority must judge independently
items.text: Closure report rejection upheld, but the Special Judge's prima facie view does not bind sanction.

items.caseName: V.G. Jegadeesan v. State
items.headline: Mosques on route no ground to deny RSS march
items.text: Police faulted for citing mosques; RSS to file route affidavit. Marches deferred to 25 Oct and 1 Nov.

items.caseName: Anburaj v. State
items.headline: Villagers may protest in crematorium over rice mill
items.text: Police refusal quashed; sit-in allowed from 29 Nov on conditions, including no obstruction of funerals.

items.caseName: ECR P. Saravanan v. State
items.headline: FIR against TVK MLA over hoardings quashed
items.text: No public structure was damaged, so continuing the case would abuse process.

items.caseName: C.V. Shanmugam v. P. Kamalakkanna
items.headline: Election petition against Mailam MLA rejected
items.text: Voter-bribery claims vague and without material facts.

items.caseName: Milany Ponnuram v. Udhayanidhi Stalin
items.headline: Plea on complaint against Udhayanidhi closed
items.text: Closed after the Magistrate numbered the S.125A RP Act complaint and issued pre-cognisance notice.

items.caseName: Md Ainul Haque v. State of Bihar
items.headline: Lying on woman, covering mouth not attempt to rape
items.text: No act towards penetration; conviction altered to S.354 IPC, term cut to time served plus ₹25,000.

items.caseName: Chandan Kumar v. State of Bihar
items.headline: Bail got by misstating HC order cancelled
items.text: Sessions bail obtained by falsely citing an HC order set aside as fraud; surrender in 3 weeks.

items.caseName: Nandu Thakur v. State of Bihar
items.headline: Holding the victim isn't common intention to kill
items.text: Man acquitted of attempt to murder; common intention not proved.

items.caseName: Santosh Bansal v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: Cheating FIRs against MLA's family quashed
items.text: FIRs over 2003 land deals filed 23 years later quashed as abuse of process.

items.caseName: Abhishek Upadhyay v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, J.
items.headline: UP Police notice to X for journalist's data quashed
items.text: Notice seeking 3 months of his data set aside; nothing gathered under it can be used. Interim protection made absolute; car to be released.
items.why: Limits sweeping police demands for a journalist’s digital records.

items.caseName: Assistant Commissioner of Central Tax, CGST Division v. Sreenivasa Rao Ravinuthala & Anr.
items.headline: IBC appeal clock starts on pronouncement, not certified copy
items.text: S.62 IBC limitation runs from the NCLAT's pronouncement; only copy time is excluded. Appeal filed 16 days late dismissed.

items.caseName: Sanjay Sureka @ Sanjay Kumar Sureka v. Directorate of Enforcement
items.coram: Aravind Kumar, Vipul M. Pancholi, JJ.
items.headline: Late forwarding of PMLA arrest order does not void arrest
items.text: A 5-day delay in sending the arrest order under S.19(2) PMLA isn't fatal. Bail still granted after 20+ months in custody.

items.caseName: Divya v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, J.
items.headline: MEA to invite claims from families of Indians killed in Ukraine war
items.text: MEA to issue a public notice for compensation claims, help families pursue Russia, and file a status report on sums paid.

items.caseName: Chintamani @ Chintu Patel v. State of Chhattisgarh
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Notice on restoring murder conviction diluted by Chhattisgarh HC
items.text: Notice on why the HC's cut to culpable homicide should not be reversed; HC seemed to ignore injuries and weapons. Listed 18 Nov.

items.caseName: Anjali Bhardwaj & Anr. v. Election Commission of India & Anr.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, J.
items.headline: Delhi SIR: hearing advanced after Form 6 complaint
items.text: Plea says deleted voters are told to file Form 6 and face prosecution. Main hearing moved from 30 to 28 October.

items.caseName: Asha Ram @ Ashumal v. State of Rajasthan
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Asaram's appeal against rape conviction to be heard in November
items.text: Plea for temporary bail to see his wife disposed as he is on parole. Registry to call for trial records ahead of the November hearing.

items.caseName: Community Against Drunken Driving v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Vikram Nath, R. Mahadevan, Aparesh Kumar Singh, JJ.
items.headline: Centre given 4 weeks on age checks at liquor outlets
items.text: No one appeared for the Union despite notice; reply due in 4 weeks and order sent to the SG. Tetra pack makers allowed to intervene.

items.caseName: Supreme Court Bar Association v. B.D. Kaushik
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, K.V. Viswanathan, J.
items.headline: Status report sought on SCBA election reforms
items.text: Election Committee to file a status report with membership data. Bar bodies asked for views on a common poll date and term caps.

items.caseName: G v. State of U.P. & 7 Ors.
items.headline: Unhappiness with a probe is not wilful neglect under SC/ST Act
items.text: S.4 needs wilful neglect of a specific duty and a prior administrative inquiry. Appeal to prosecute 7 officials dismissed.

items.caseName: GS v. State of U.P. & 2 Ors.
items.headline: Alleged co-adulterer must be heard before adverse finding
items.text: Maintenance of ₹20,000 + ₹10,000 upheld. Chief Justice asked to consider rules on notice to named third persons in S.125 cases.

items.caseName: Breach Candy Hospital Trust v. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax & Ors.
items.coram: B.P. Colabawalla, Farhan P. Dubash, JJ.
items.headline: Charging patients does not end a hospital’s charitable status
items.text: Refusals quashed; Trust to be approved under S.10(23C)(via) for AY 2002-03 to 2021-22.

items.caseName: Phantom Studios v. JioStar India & Ors.
items.headline: No interim stay on 'Queen Forever'
items.text: Interim injunction refused against JioStar's film, said to be an unauthorised sequel to 2014's 'Queen'. Detailed order awaited.

items.caseName: Uddhab Singh Babu & Anr. v. Hemanta Kumar Singh Manki
items.headline: Succession Act overrides primogeniture custom
items.text: S.4 HSA overrides the Mankiary estate custom; second appeal allowed, suit dismissal restored, ₹50,000 costs.

items.caseName: Mahua Moitra v. State of West Bengal
items.headline: Moitra may contest State’s security claim
items.text: She may file a supplementary affidavit and add the MHA; State’s 9 Oct security memo to be shared. Listed 2 Dec.

items.caseName: Ridhima Singh & Anr. v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Nitin Wasudeo Sambre, ACJ, Sanjay Sharma, J.
items.headline: Notice on PIL against 'analogue paneer'
items.text: Centre, FSSAI and Delhi govt asked to respond on dairy analogues sold as paneer. No interim relief yet.

items.caseName: Nurul Hoque v. Union of India & 5 Ors.
items.coram: Kalyan Rai Surana, Shamima Jahan, JJ.
items.headline: Forged pleadings justify dismissal at the threshold
items.text: Foreigner finding upheld on merits too; interim bail recalled and the vakalatnama sent to the Bar Council.

items.caseName: Mohamadi Masjid Jamat v. State of Gujarat & Ors.
items.headline: Kutch Collector must answer mosque demolition plea
items.text: Collector to file an affidavit by 19 Oct on alleged demolition without due process. Listed 22 Oct.

items.caseName: Jehangir Iqbal Ganie v. Mohd Amin Dar & Ors.
items.headline: CAT costs on senior advocate stayed
items.text: ₹10,000 costs over his virtual appearance stayed. Tribunal members and parties called to chambers on 21 Oct.

items.caseName: Sushil Kumar Biswas v. State of Jharkhand & Ors.
items.headline: No nuisance case without a preliminary S.133 order
items.text: SDM skipped the preliminary order and evidence; orders set aside and matter remanded to SDM, Madhupur.

items.caseName: A v. M
items.coram: Sujit Narayan Prasad, Sanjay Prasad, JJ.
items.headline: Mother's absence no ground to alter interim custody
items.text: Non-appearance is for the trial court; S.151 CPC application dismissed. No deadline set for the Family Court.

items.caseName: Mubarak Shariff & Ors. v. State by K.R. Pet Rural Police & Anr.
items.headline: Riot-provocation case against 17 near dargah quashed
items.text: Only police who overheard from behind a fence; no independent witness. Continuing would abuse process.

items.caseName: Najeeb v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Courts must view the CDs before convicting for obscenity
items.text: Trial court relied only on the officer's opinion without viewing the CDs; conviction under S.292 IPC set aside.

items.caseName: Uma Devi Navaiya v. State of Madhya Pradesh & Ors.
items.coram: Alpesh Y. Kogje, CJ, Vivek Jain, J.
items.headline: SC status does not travel across States
items.text: A migrant cannot claim SC benefits in the new State even if the caste is notified in both. Certificate refusal upheld.

items.caseName: ABVM Society of the Catholic Apostolate (Pallottines) v. A. Deiva Nayagam & Ors.
items.coram: N. Anand Venkatesh, K.K. Ramakrishnan, JJ.
items.headline: Priest's post-vow property belongs to his Society
items.text: Relatives' succession certificate set aside; about ₹56 lakh in deposits to be returned within a month.

items.caseName: Waiz Khan v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Go to the High Court first over ATS house entry
items.text: Art. 32 plea alleging UP ATS men entered a house without uniform or ID was not entertained; petitioner may approach the HC.

items.caseName: Rahul Gandhi v. State of Maharashtra & Anr.
items.coram: Vikram Nath, Aparesh Kumar Singh, JJ.
items.headline: Defamation trial over 'commander-in-thief' remark stayed
items.text: Notice on plea against Bombay HC's refusal to quash the case, returnable in 4 weeks. Trial court proceedings stayed meanwhile.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Notice on ADR plea against lifelong immunity for CEC, ECs
items.text: Notice to Union and ECI on challenge to S.16 of the 2023 CEC Act; tagged with the pending Lok Prahari petition.
items.why: Tests whether election commissioners can be shielded from suits for life.

items.caseName: Jagtar Singh Hawara v. Government of NCT of Delhi & Ors.
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: IB inputs sought on Beant Singh convict's jail transfer plea
items.text: Delhi govt to seek IB's view on moving Hawara from Tihar to a Punjab jail. Listed on 3 November.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Senior police officer summoned over assault on women journalists
items.text: NWMI plea on alleged assault of women journalists covering Delhi protests listed on 15 Oct; a senior officer must attend.

items.caseName: Sachin Yadav v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Police misbehaving with govt advocates may face contempt
items.text: DGP to circulate a warning to police. Azamgarh SSP's PRO held in custody till 5 PM for misbehaving with an AGA; bail plea rejected.

items.caseName: Christian Community Welfare Society v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.headline: No right to a specific plot for a cemetery
items.text: Religious freedom gives no enforceable claim to a particular local-body plot; allotting land is an executive call. Writ dismissed.

items.caseName: Joseph Khudawant & Ors. v. State of Maharashtra & Anr.
items.headline: Promoting one's religion is not outraging religious feelings
items.text: Urging someone to convert was mere promotion of religion, not an offence under S.299/302 BNS. FIR and chargesheet quashed.

items.caseName: Rays of New Beginning Foundation v. Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board & Ors.
items.headline: 'First come, first serve' Ramleela ground allotment arbitrary
items.text: No relief for this season, but DUSIB must frame annual allotment guidelines with a notice 90 days ahead and a common window.

items.caseName: Uday Bhanu Chib v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: Notice on Youth Congress plea to protest against CEC
items.text: Notice on three prayers, incl. fresh reasoned review of the protest request and the 10-day rule. Listed 17 Nov.

items.caseName: Yogesh Taneja v. Vinay Taneja
items.headline: Is the 120-day written statement deadline mandatory?
items.text: Bench prima facie found the Original Side Rules deadline directory and referred it to a larger bench. Only the Court can extend time.

items.caseName: Sunny v. State of NCT of Delhi
items.headline: S.37 NDPS rigour eased when quantity is barely commercial
items.text: Bail for 259.3 g morphine, just over the 250 g limit. Long delay can justify bail despite S.37.

items.caseName: Amritprava Mahanta v. State of Assam
items.headline: Bail to accused in Zubeen Garg death case
items.text: Bail after nearly a year in custody; no prima facie conspiracy shown. She must not travel abroad without leave.

items.caseName: Sandeepkumar Radhakrushnalal Shrivastav v. State of Gujarat
items.headline: Absence from home doesn't make an accused an absconder
items.text: Proclamation quashed; Head Constable to be prosecuted for a forged report. Guidelines issued to trial courts.

items.caseName: Dr. Ravi Basalingappagowda Patil v. State of Karnataka
items.headline: SIR: probe against BJP leader over voter deletions stayed
items.text: Investigation into alleged bulk Form 7 objections to delete Muslim voters stayed till 29 Oct, following a coordinate bench.

items.caseName: Pinarayi Vijayan v. Adv. K.M. Shajahan & Ors.
items.headline: CMRL-Exalogic: no stay on vigilance FIR order; verdict reserved
items.text: Verdict reserved on pleas of Pinarayi Vijayan, Veena T. and Muhammed Riyas; interim stay of the FIR order refused.

items.caseName: K. Ponmudy v. Assistant Director
items.coram: S.A. Dharmadhikari, CJ, G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: PMLA case against ex-minister Ponmudi quashed
items.text: With acquittal in the predicate offence, the ED case cannot go on. ED may act if the predicate case is revived.

items.caseName: Agri S.S. Krishnamurthy v. The Speaker & Ors.
items.coram: S.A. Dharmadhikari, CJ, G. Arul Murugan, J.
items.headline: Speaker's acceptance of AIADMK MLAs' resignations upheld
items.text: Resignations found genuine, but Tenth Schedule disqualification proceedings can go on; Speaker to finish them in 2 months.

items.caseName: Ankur Kumar Jain v. State rep. by the Inspector of Police & Anr.
items.headline: No written grounds of arrest is dereliction of duty
items.text: Oral explanation is not enough; arrest and remand vitiated and bail granted. DGP to instruct all police units.

items.caseName: G v. B
items.headline: Children's welfare can't force spouses to stay in a dead marriage
items.text: Husband's appeal dismissed; divorce for cruelty upheld as trust had broken down.

items.caseName: Milany Ponnuram v. Udhayanidhi Stalin
items.headline: Magistrate's report sought on unnumbered poll complaint
items.text: Georgetown Magistrate to say how long it will take to number the corrupt-practice complaint against Udhayanidhi Stalin.

items.caseName: Jagtar Singh v. State of Punjab
items.headline: No pre-arrest bail for smuggling heroin into jail
items.text: Heroin was hidden in cream boxes for his undertrial brother; custodial interrogation needed. Plea dismissed.

items.caseName: Shri Manik Sharma v. State of Tripura
items.coram: T. Amarnath Goud, Biswajit Palit, JJ.
items.headline: No quashing of FIR against ex-CM Manik Sarkar over speech
items.text: Remarks need investigation; S.192 BNS can apply even if no riot follows. He must avoid provocative speeches.

items.caseName: Siddaramaiah v. Freedom TV & Ors.

items.headline: Ex-CM Siddaramaiah gets gag order against 42 media outlets
items.text: Ex parte interim injunction bars circulating two 'honey-trap' videos; platforms to block them. Summons on 13 Nov.

items.caseName: Arcis Clean Energy Pvt. Ltd. v. Parshva Innovation
items.headline: Governing-law clause can decide the seat when two venues are named
items.text: Where a clause names two venues, an exclusive-jurisdiction clause helps fix the seat. Goa held the seat; Delhi HC lacked S.11 jurisdiction.
items.why: Guides courts on which High Court can appoint arbitrators.

items.caseName: H. Nagarajan & Ors. v. State of T.N. & Ors.
items.headline: Ad hoc service counts for pension, not seniority
items.text: Ad hoc appointees get seniority only from regularisation, not over direct recruits; earlier service may count for pension.

items.caseName: Haramani Sahoo & Ors. v. Lalita Nayak & Ors.
items.headline: Plaint amendment allowed if new facts tie to the dispute
items.text: A late amendment can't be refused just because it widens the suit, if new facts and reliefs link directly to the existing dispute.

items.caseName: State of Punjab v. Nikhil Saraf
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Prasanna B. Varale, JJ.
items.headline: No stay of CBI FIR against Punjab CM's OSD, but no coercive steps
items.text: Notice on Punjab's plea against the HC order directing a CBI FIR. FIR not stayed; no coercive action; State to cooperate.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: SIT probe into assault on lawyers outside BCI office
items.text: Delhi Police Commissioner to form an SIT led by at least a DCP. Lawyers may also approach the Magistrate meanwhile.

items.caseName: Aakash Goel v. Union of India & Anr.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Centre asked for Census 2027 SOP on caste self-declaration
items.text: Without issuing notice, SC asked the Union to file the Census SOP and explain how OBC/ST status is declared and verified.

items.caseName: RK v. State of U.P.
items.headline: HC asks Law Commission to suggest POCSO changes
items.text: Habeas plea allowed as wife found to be a major. Law Commission asked to consider sentencing discretion in exceptional POCSO cases.

items.caseName: Saradindu Chakravarty v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: SC Commission can't declare an FIR false
items.text: The National Commission for SCs is advisory under Art. 338 and cannot rule an FIR false; its proceedings were set aside.

items.caseName: Janta Live Press Network Pvt. Ltd. & Anr. v. Google LLC & Ors.
items.headline: No writ against Google for suspending a Gmail account
items.text: Running or suspending email on security grounds is not a public function, so Art. 226 writ does not lie. Other remedies left open.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: National Herald: AJL not restrained from seeking release of properties
items.text: No interim order on ED's plea to stop AJL seeking release of attached properties. Listed on 2 Nov.

items.caseName: Molana Mohammad Ramzan Janmohammad v. State of Gujarat & Anr.
items.headline: Bail to cleric accused of conversion and minor's marriage
items.text: Bail granted as probe is over, chargesheet filed, no antecedents and custody since June.

items.caseName: Rajeshbhai @ Valku Devchandbhai Jiyani & Ors. v. State of Gujarat
items.headline: No anticipatory bail for three, incl. woman, in rape-video case
items.text: Prima facie material against all three; the phone said to hold the video is yet to be recovered.

items.caseName: Court on its Own Motion v. State of Jharkhand & Ors.
items.coram: M.S. Sonak, CJ, Manoj Prasad, J.
items.headline: Contempt notice over delay in police-station CCTVs
items.text: Repeated delay held prima facie disobedience. Show-cause to the Addl. Chief Secretary; Chief Secretary to file a timeline.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.coram: Sujit Narayan Prasad, Sanjay Prasad, JJ.
items.headline: Desertion needs abandoning marital duties, not just leaving home
items.text: A wife forced out by cruelty is not a deserter. Her appeal was allowed and the marriage dissolved.

items.caseName: Mahendra Kumar Mitra & Ors. v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Vibhu Bakhru, CJ, K.S. Hemalekha, J.
items.headline: 2022 law raising SC/ST quota struck down for breaching 50% cap
items.text: Ss. 3 and 4 of the 2022 Act struck down as total reservation crossed 50%. Prior consultation with SC/ST Commissions is mandatory.
items.why: Affects SC/ST quotas in Karnataka jobs and education.

items.caseName: P v. S
items.headline: Cruelty under Special Marriage Act counts 'since' marriage
items.text: S.27(1)(d) SMA cruelty must be shown since solemnisation; mental disorder ground needs proper diagnosis. Husband's appeal dismissed.

items.caseName: K.A. Muhammed Ashraf & Anr. v. Muslim Girls' Higher Secondary School & Ors.
items.coram: Anil K. Narendran, Muralee Krishna S., JJ.
items.headline: Order allowing co-education at girls' school set aside
items.text: Single Judge order set aside and case remanded. Power to permit co-education lies with the Director of Education.

items.caseName: State of Kerala & Anr. v. Kerala Police Officers' Association & Ors.
items.coram: A.K. Jayasankaran Nambiar, Preeta A.K., JJ.
items.headline: State's appeal on police associations admitted
items.text: Appeals admitted against the Single Judge ruling that quashed the merger of police associations.

items.caseName: XXX v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.headline: ₹21,000 post-surgery aid to be paid to transgender person
items.text: State to pay the unpaid balance of scheme aid within two months; plea for interest not granted.

items.caseName: Sanjeet Singh Mavai v. CBI
items.headline: Supervisory rank alone doesn't prove guilt for custodial death
items.text: Bail to police officer after a year in custody; chargesheet filed and evidence mainly documentary and CCTV.

items.caseName: CTR Nirmal Kumar v. Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
items.coram: N. Satish Kumar, G.K. Muthukumar, JJ.
items.headline: DMK defamation suit not to be numbered for now
items.text: Registry told not to number DMK's suit against two TVK Ministers until the Minister's appeal is heard.

items.coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, CJ, Rohit Kapoor, J.
items.headline: Gaps flagged in police probe into LPU violence
items.text: State given one more chance before transfer to an independent agency; probe to be supervised by a senior officer. Listed 27 Oct.

items.caseName: Ramkrushna Prahllad Dongardive v. State of Maharashtra
items.coram: Ujjal Bhuyan, Atul S. Chandurkar, JJ.
items.headline: Search lapses don't void a seizure, but weaken it
items.text: Breach of S.100 CrPC affects only the weight of seizure evidence. HC's reversal set aside; acquittal restored.

items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: After IBC plan, counterclaim works only as set-off

items.caseName: Shubham Equipment Pvt. Ltd. v. Rothwell Water Company Ltd.

items.headline: Sole arbitrator named in joint venture dispute
items.text: JV and MoU disputes go under their own clauses, not the Korea-seated one. Former CJ R.D. Dhanuka appointed.

items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: NALSA to decide Lok Adalat members' pay plea

items.headline: Bail after 10 months; probe called 'sham paperwork'
items.text: Cyber-fraud accused bailed as the probe had stalled and co-accused were never traced.

hi.headline: गुजराती अख़बार को 'आज तक' नाम छोड़ना होगा
hi.text: दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय के पासिंग-ऑफ़ निर्णय के विरुद्ध याचिका खारिज; अख़बार को नया नाम अपनाने के लिए तीन महीने मिले, उसकी माँगी गई छह महीने की मोहलत नहीं।

mr.headline: गुजराती वृत्तपत्राला 'आज तक' नाव सोडावे लागणार
mr.text: दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालयाच्या पासिंग-ऑफ निकालाविरुद्धची याचिका फेटाळली; वृत्तपत्राला नवे नाव घेण्यासाठी तीन महिने मिळाले, मागितलेले सहा महिने नाहीत.

items.caseName: V. Pon. Paneerselvam v. S. Regupathy
items.coram: Prashant Kumar Mishra, Shree Chandrashekhar, JJ.
items.headline: Election petition must be filed by petitioner himself
items.text: An RP Act election petition presented by counsel, not the petitioner in person, is liable to dismissal.

hi.headline: चुनाव याचिका याचिकाकर्ता को स्वयं दायर करनी होगी
hi.text: लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम के तहत जो चुनाव याचिका याचिकाकर्ता ने स्वयं नहीं, बल्कि वकील ने प्रस्तुत की हो, वह खारिज की जा सकती है।

mr.headline: निवडणूक याचिका याचिकाकर्त्याने स्वतःच दाखल करावी
mr.text: लोकप्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियमाअंतर्गतची निवडणूक याचिका याचिकाकर्त्याने स्वतः नव्हे तर वकिलाने सादर केली असल्यास ती फेटाळली जाऊ शकते.

items.caseName: M/s. MEPCO Industries Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income Tax
items.coram: Prashant Kumar Mishra, Shree Chandrashekhar, JJ.
items.headline: Power subsidy cutting running costs is taxable
items.text: Applying the purpose test, a power subsidy tied to electricity charges was a revenue receipt; appeal dismissed.

hi.headline: चालू खर्च घटाने वाली बिजली सब्सिडी कर-योग्य है
hi.text: उद्देश्य की कसौटी लगाकर, बिजली शुल्क से जुड़ी बिजली सब्सिडी को राजस्व प्राप्ति माना गया; अपील खारिज।

mr.headline: चालू खर्च कमी करणारे वीज अनुदान करपात्र
mr.text: उद्देशाची कसोटी लावून, वीज शुल्काशी जोडलेले वीज अनुदान महसुली जमा ठरवले; अपील फेटाळले.

items.caseName: State of West Bengal v. Milan Pradhan
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; V. Mohana, J.
items.headline: Interim bail to Nandigram candidate left intact
items.text: State's plea dismissed; interim bail stands till 20 Oct so he can contest and attend counting, then surrender.

hi.headline: नंदीग्राम के उम्मीदवार की अंतरिम ज़मानत बरकरार
hi.text: राज्य की याचिका खारिज; अंतरिम ज़मानत 20 अक्टूबर तक बनी रहेगी ताकि वह चुनाव लड़ सकें और मतगणना में शामिल हो सकें, उसके बाद आत्मसमर्पण करना होगा।

mr.headline: नंदीग्रामच्या उमेदवाराचा अंतरिम जामीन कायम
mr.text: राज्याची याचिका फेटाळली; अंतरिम जामीन 20 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत कायम राहील, जेणेकरून ते निवडणूक लढवू शकतील व मतमोजणीला हजर राहू शकतील, त्यानंतर शरण यावे लागेल.

items.caseName: Nallapu Manideep v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: AP High Court to monitor anti-malaria death probe
items.text: Case over a girl's death after a chloroquine drive sent to the AP HC to monitor the probe on priority.

hi.headline: मलेरिया-रोधी अभियान में मृत्यु की जाँच पर आंध्र प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालय निगरानी करेगा
hi.text: क्लोरोक्वीन अभियान के बाद एक बच्ची की मृत्यु का मामला आंध्र प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालय को भेजा गया, जो प्राथमिकता से जाँच की निगरानी करेगा।

mr.headline: मलेरियाविरोधी मोहिमेतील मृत्यूच्या तपासावर आंध्र प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालय देखरेख ठेवणार
mr.text: क्लोरोक्विन मोहिमेनंतर एका मुलीच्या मृत्यूचे प्रकरण आंध्र प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालयाकडे पाठवले; ते प्राधान्याने तपासावर देखरेख ठेवेल.

items.caseName: Rajpal Naurang Yadav v. M/s Murli Projects Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Rajpal Yadav cheque cases: more deposit ordered
items.text: ₹1.15 crore deposited; ₹85 lakh more due by 13 Oct. Court warned the sentence could be enhanced.

hi.headline: राजपाल यादव चेक मामले: और राशि जमा करने का आदेश
hi.text: ₹1.15 करोड़ जमा हो चुके हैं; ₹85 लाख और 13 अक्टूबर तक जमा करने होंगे। न्यायालय ने चेतावनी दी कि सज़ा बढ़ाई जा सकती है।

mr.headline: राजपाल यादव धनादेश प्रकरणे: आणखी रक्कम जमा करण्याचा आदेश
mr.text: ₹1.15 कोटी जमा झाले; आणखी ₹85 लाख 13 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत भरावे लागतील. शिक्षा वाढवली जाऊ शकते, असा इशारा न्यायालयाने दिला.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: Noida man's illegal detention: release ordered
items.text: Habeas plea allowed: he was held before any FIR or S.130 BNSS notice. Release ordered.

hi.headline: नोएडा के व्यक्ति की अवैध हिरासत: रिहाई का आदेश
hi.text: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण याचिका स्वीकार: उसे किसी एफ़आईआर या BNSS की धारा 130 के नोटिस से पहले ही पकड़ा गया था। रिहाई का आदेश दिया गया।

mr.headline: नोएडातील व्यक्तीची बेकायदा स्थानबद्धता: सुटकेचा आदेश
mr.text: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण याचिका मंजूर: कोणताही एफआयआर किंवा BNSS कलम 130 ची नोटीस नसताना त्याला ताब्यात घेतले होते. सुटकेचा आदेश दिला.

items.caseName: United India Insurance Co. Ltd. v. C. Nagamani & Ors.
items.headline: Accident award can exceed the amount claimed
items.text: Tribunals must award what evidence supports; compensation raised to ₹29.89 lakh.

hi.headline: दुर्घटना मुआवज़ा दावे की राशि से अधिक हो सकता है
hi.text: अधिकरणों को उतना मुआवज़ा देना चाहिए जितना साक्ष्य से सिद्ध हो; मुआवज़ा बढ़ाकर ₹29.89 लाख किया गया।

mr.headline: अपघात भरपाई दाव्याच्या रकमेपेक्षा जास्त असू शकते
mr.text: पुराव्याने सिद्ध होईल तेवढी भरपाई न्यायाधिकरणांनी द्यावी; भरपाई वाढवून ₹29.89 लाख केली.

items.caseName: Amit Supekar & Anr. v. State of Maharashtra & Ors.
items.coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, CJ; Advait Sethna, J.
items.headline: MPSC protest: State told to report on vacancies
items.text: Notice to State; report on MPSC inquiry and vacancies due in 3 weeks. Protesting students aren't anti-social.

hi.headline: MPSC आंदोलन: राज्य से रिक्तियों पर रिपोर्ट माँगी
hi.text: राज्य को नोटिस; MPSC जाँच और रिक्तियों पर 3 सप्ताह में रिपोर्ट देनी होगी। आंदोलन कर रहे छात्र असामाजिक तत्व नहीं हैं।

mr.headline: MPSC आंदोलन: राज्याकडून रिक्त पदांचा अहवाल मागवला
mr.text: राज्याला नोटीस; MPSC चौकशी व रिक्त पदांचा अहवाल 3 आठवड्यांत द्यावा. आंदोलन करणारे विद्यार्थी समाजविघातक नाहीत.

items.caseName: Kannamwar Co-op Hsg. Soc. Association v. Union of India
items.headline: BMC told to file disease data over Mumbai garbage
items.text: BMC to give hospital data on dengue, malaria and H1N1; Court to monitor hygiene in all wards. Next date 22 Oct.

hi.headline: मुंबई में कचरे के मामले में BMC से बीमारियों के आँकड़े माँगे
hi.text: BMC डेंगू, मलेरिया और H1N1 के अस्पताल आँकड़े देगी; न्यायालय सभी वार्डों में स्वच्छता की निगरानी करेगा। अगली सुनवाई 22 अक्टूबर।

mr.headline: मुंबईतील कचऱ्याप्रकरणी BMC कडून आजारांची आकडेवारी मागवली
mr.text: BMC डेंग्यू, मलेरिया व H1N1 ची रुग्णालयीन आकडेवारी देईल; न्यायालय सर्व प्रभागांतील स्वच्छतेवर देखरेख ठेवेल. पुढील सुनावणी 22 ऑक्टोबर.

items.caseName: Chahat Raghav v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Nitin Wasudeo Sambre, ACJ; Arun Bhardwaj, J.
items.headline: Centre to decide body-worn camera plea in 6 months
items.text: PIL for body cameras on police at protests disposed of; Centre to decide it as a representation in 6 months.

hi.headline: बॉडी-वॉर्न कैमरे की माँग पर केंद्र 6 महीने में निर्णय ले
hi.text: प्रदर्शनों में पुलिस पर बॉडी कैमरे लगाने की जनहित याचिका का निपटारा; केंद्र इसे अभ्यावेदन मानकर 6 महीने में निर्णय लेगा।

mr.headline: बॉडी-वॉर्न कॅमेऱ्यांच्या मागणीवर केंद्राने 6 महिन्यांत निर्णय घ्यावा
mr.text: आंदोलनांच्या वेळी पोलिसांना बॉडी कॅमेरे लावण्याची जनहित याचिका निकाली; केंद्र हे निवेदन मानून 6 महिन्यांत निर्णय घेईल.

items.caseName: Sarifuddin v. State of Assam & 17 Ors.
items.coram: Kalyan Rai Surana, Susmita Phukan Khaund, JJ.
items.headline: ₹5 lakh for death in illegal police custody
items.text: 2012 arrest illegal (no 41A notice or memo); ₹5 lakh in 3 months, recoverable from guilty officers.

hi.headline: अवैध पुलिस हिरासत में मृत्यु पर ₹5 लाख
hi.text: 2012 की गिरफ्तारी अवैध थी (न 41A नोटिस, न ज्ञापन); 3 महीने में ₹5 लाख, जिसे दोषी अधिकारियों से वसूला जा सकता है।

mr.headline: बेकायदा पोलीस कोठडीतील मृत्यूसाठी ₹5 लाख
mr.text: 2012 ची अटक बेकायदा होती (41A नोटीस किंवा मेमो नाही); 3 महिन्यांत ₹5 लाख, जे दोषी अधिकाऱ्यांकडून वसूल करता येतील.

items.caseName: Atul Kumar Sabarwal v. State of Karnataka & Ors.
items.headline: FIR over 'jihadi' Facebook post quashed
items.text: Using the word 'jihadi' in a post made out no offence under Sections 295A or 505(2) IPC.

hi.headline: 'जिहादी' फ़ेसबुक पोस्ट पर एफ़आईआर रद्द
hi.text: पोस्ट में 'जिहादी' शब्द के उपयोग से IPC की धारा 295A या 505(2) के तहत कोई अपराध नहीं बनता।

mr.headline: 'जिहादी' फेसबुक पोस्टवरील एफआयआर रद्द
mr.text: पोस्टमध्ये 'जिहादी' शब्द वापरल्याने IPC कलम 295A किंवा 505(2) अंतर्गत कोणताही गुन्हा होत नाही.

items.caseName: Winzo US Inc. & Anr. v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: Order reserved on WinZO plea over ED-attached funds
items.text: Order reserved on WinZO's plea to shift ED-attached funds to another US bank account; ED opposed.

hi.headline: ED द्वारा कुर्क धन पर WinZO की याचिका पर आदेश सुरक्षित
hi.text: ED द्वारा कुर्क धन को अमेरिका के दूसरे बैंक खाते में ले जाने की WinZO की याचिका पर आदेश सुरक्षित; ED ने विरोध किया।

mr.headline: ED ने जप्त केलेल्या निधीवरील WinZO च्या याचिकेवर आदेश राखून ठेवला
mr.text: ED ने जप्त केलेला निधी अमेरिकेतील दुसऱ्या बँक खात्यात हलवण्याच्या WinZO च्या याचिकेवर आदेश राखून ठेवला; ED ने विरोध केला.

items.caseName: Byju Raveendran v. Pankaj Srivastava
items.headline: Byju Raveendran's contempt plea against IRP withdrawn
items.text: Bench found no breach shown; contempt plea against the IRP dismissed as withdrawn.

hi.headline: बायजू रवींद्रन की IRP के विरुद्ध अवमानना याचिका वापस
hi.text: पीठ को कोई उल्लंघन नहीं दिखा; IRP के विरुद्ध अवमानना याचिका वापस लेने के आधार पर खारिज।

mr.headline: बायजू रवींद्रन यांची IRP विरुद्धची अवमान याचिका मागे
mr.text: खंडपीठाला कोणतेही उल्लंघन दिसले नाही; IRP विरुद्धची अवमान याचिका मागे घेतल्याने फेटाळली.

items.caseName: L (Minor) v. State of Karnataka & Ors.
items.headline: Minor may change name for astrological reasons
items.text: Being known by one's name is a civil right; suit maintainable and records to be changed.

hi.headline: नाबालिग ज्योतिषीय कारणों से नाम बदल सकता है
hi.text: अपने नाम से पहचाना जाना एक नागरिक अधिकार है; वाद सुनवाई योग्य है और अभिलेख बदले जाएँगे।

mr.headline: अल्पवयीन मुलगा ज्योतिषीय कारणांसाठी नाव बदलू शकतो
mr.text: स्वतःच्या नावाने ओळखले जाणे हा नागरी हक्क आहे; दावा चालवण्यायोग्य असून नोंदी बदलल्या जातील.

items.caseName: Manjunath v. State of Karnataka & Anr.
items.headline: SC/ST Act case against cameraman quashed
items.text: No intent shown: filming a vaccination drive that caught a woman by chance is no offence.

hi.headline: कैमरामैन के विरुद्ध SC/ST अधिनियम का मामला रद्द
hi.text: कोई इरादा नहीं दिखा: टीकाकरण अभियान की वीडियो बनाते समय संयोग से एक महिला का कैमरे में आ जाना अपराध नहीं है।

mr.headline: कॅमेरामनविरुद्धचे SC/ST अधिनियमाचे प्रकरण रद्द
mr.text: हेतू दिसला नाही: लसीकरण मोहिमेचे चित्रीकरण करताना एखादी महिला योगायोगाने कॅमेऱ्यात येणे हा गुन्हा नाही.

items.caseName: A v. M
items.headline: Say 'parenting time', not 'visitation'
items.text: Family courts told to use 'parenting time'; order giving father 50% custody stayed. Listed 15 Oct.

hi.headline: 'विज़िटेशन' नहीं, 'पेरेंटिंग टाइम' कहें
hi.text: कुटुंब न्यायालयों को 'पेरेंटिंग टाइम' शब्द उपयोग करने को कहा; पिता को 50% कस्टडी देने वाले आदेश पर रोक। सुनवाई 15 अक्टूबर को।

mr.headline: 'व्हिजिटेशन' नव्हे, 'पेरेंटिंग टाइम' म्हणा
mr.text: कौटुंबिक न्यायालयांनी 'पेरेंटिंग टाइम' हा शब्द वापरावा; वडिलांना 50% ताबा देणाऱ्या आदेशाला स्थगिती. सुनावणी 15 ऑक्टोबरला.

items.caseName: Suo Motu v. State of Kerala
items.coram: Raja Vijayaraghavan V., K.V. Jayakumar, JJ.
items.headline: Sabarimala gold theft: deadlines set for SIT
items.text: SIT to seek sanction and file final reports by 25 Oct (doorframes) and 25 Nov (Dwarapalaka).

hi.headline: सबरीमाला सोना चोरी: SIT के लिए समय-सीमा तय
hi.text: SIT मंज़ूरी लेकर 25 अक्टूबर (दरवाज़े की चौखट) और 25 नवंबर (द्वारपालक) तक अंतिम रिपोर्ट दाखिल करेगी।

mr.headline: शबरीमला सोने चोरी: SIT साठी कालमर्यादा ठरवली
mr.text: SIT मंजुरी घेऊन 25 ऑक्टोबर (दरवाजाची चौकट) व 25 नोव्हेंबर (द्वारपालक) पर्यंत अंतिम अहवाल दाखल करेल.

items.caseName: Mohammed J.I. & Ors. v. State of Kerala & Anr.
items.headline: No in-camera trial in Abhimanyu murder case
items.text: In-camera trial refused, but no photos or video of the accused in court; entry may be limited for eyewitnesses.

hi.headline: अभिमन्यु हत्या मामले में बंद कमरे में सुनवाई नहीं
hi.text: बंद कमरे में सुनवाई से इनकार, पर अदालत में आरोपियों की फ़ोटो या वीडियो नहीं ली जाएगी; प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों के बयान के समय प्रवेश सीमित किया जा सकता है।

mr.headline: अभिमन्यू खून प्रकरणात बंद दाराआड सुनावणी नाही
mr.text: बंद दाराआड सुनावणी नाकारली, पण न्यायालयात आरोपींचे फोटो किंवा व्हिडिओ घेता येणार नाहीत; प्रत्यक्षदर्शींच्या साक्षीवेळी प्रवेश मर्यादित करता येईल.

items.caseName: AIIMS Kasargod Janakeeya Koottayma v. Union of India
items.coram: Soumen Sen, CJ; Syam Kumar V.M., J.
items.headline: Centre to review AIIMS proposal for Kerala
items.text: Better healthcare can't lower Kerala's priority; Centre's assurance to review recorded. Listed after 6 weeks.

hi.headline: केरल के लिए AIIMS प्रस्ताव की केंद्र समीक्षा करेगा
hi.text: बेहतर स्वास्थ्य सेवा होने से केरल की प्राथमिकता कम नहीं हो सकती; समीक्षा का केंद्र का आश्वासन दर्ज किया गया। सुनवाई 6 सप्ताह बाद।

mr.headline: केरळसाठीच्या AIIMS प्रस्तावाचा केंद्र आढावा घेणार
mr.text: आरोग्यसेवा चांगली असल्याने केरळचे प्राधान्य कमी होऊ शकत नाही; आढावा घेण्याचे केंद्राचे आश्वासन नोंदवले. सुनावणी 6 आठवड्यांनंतर.

items.caseName: Sindhu S. Nair v. State of Kerala & Anr.
items.headline: Headmistress in churidar must be let into school
items.text: Choice of dress is personal; police to ensure she can enter the school.

hi.headline: चूड़ीदार पहनने वाली प्रधानाध्यापिका को स्कूल में आने दिया जाए
hi.text: पोशाक चुनना व्यक्तिगत अधिकार है; पुलिस सुनिश्चित करेगी कि वह स्कूल में प्रवेश कर सकें।

mr.headline: चुडीदार परिधान करणाऱ्या मुख्याध्यापिकेला शाळेत येऊ द्यावे
mr.text: पोशाखाची निवड हा वैयक्तिक प्रश्न आहे; त्या शाळेत प्रवेश करू शकतील याची पोलिसांनी खात्री करावी.

items.caseName: Anilkumar v. Anitha Kumari & Ors.
items.headline: Delay condonation can't require a deposit
items.text: A deposit of the award fits only a stay of execution, not delay condonation. Matter remanded.

hi.headline: विलंब माफ़ी के लिए राशि जमा करने की शर्त नहीं लगाई जा सकती
hi.text: अवार्ड की राशि जमा करने की शर्त केवल निष्पादन पर रोक के लिए उचित है, विलंब माफ़ी के लिए नहीं। मामला वापस भेजा गया।

mr.headline: विलंब माफीसाठी रक्कम जमा करण्याची अट घालता येणार नाही
mr.text: निवाड्याची रक्कम जमा करण्याची अट केवळ अंमलबजावणीच्या स्थगितीसाठी योग्य आहे, विलंब माफीसाठी नाही. प्रकरण परत पाठवले.

items.caseName: X & Anr. v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.headline: 498A case against in-laws goes to trial
items.text: Dowry cruelty case against parents-in-law to proceed; case against husband's brother quashed as vague.

hi.headline: ससुराल वालों के विरुद्ध 498A मामले में मुकदमा चलेगा
hi.text: सास-ससुर के विरुद्ध दहेज क्रूरता का मामला चलेगा; पति के भाई के विरुद्ध मामला अस्पष्ट होने के कारण रद्द।

mr.headline: सासरच्यांविरुद्धचा 498A खटला चालणार
mr.text: सासू-सासऱ्यांविरुद्धचा हुंडा क्रूरतेचा खटला चालेल; पतीच्या भावाविरुद्धचे प्रकरण अस्पष्ट असल्याने रद्द.

items.caseName: Kanzeon Public Charitable Trust v. Union of India
items.headline: FCRA registration denied to Zen meditation trust
items.text: Trust should have declared it is religious; foreign funding is a privilege, not a right.

hi.headline: ज़ेन ध्यान ट्रस्ट को FCRA पंजीकरण नहीं
hi.text: ट्रस्ट को बताना चाहिए था कि वह धार्मिक है; विदेशी अंशदान एक विशेषाधिकार है, अधिकार नहीं।

mr.headline: झेन ध्यान ट्रस्टला FCRA नोंदणी नाकारली
mr.text: ट्रस्टने आपण धार्मिक असल्याचे जाहीर करायला हवे होते; परदेशी देणगी हा विशेषाधिकार आहे, हक्क नाही.

items.caseName: Ala Alagappan v. Additional Director, Directorate of Enforcement
items.headline: PMLA bail; ED told to chase big scams
items.text: Bail granted as ED didn't link the property to a scheduled offence; ED urged to focus on national-level scams.

hi.headline: PMLA में ज़मानत; ED बड़े घोटालों पर ध्यान दे
hi.text: ज़मानत दी गई क्योंकि ED संपत्ति को किसी अनुसूचित अपराध से नहीं जोड़ पाई; ED से राष्ट्रीय स्तर के घोटालों पर ध्यान देने का आग्रह।

mr.headline: PMLA मध्ये जामीन; ED ने मोठ्या घोटाळ्यांकडे लक्ष द्यावे
mr.text: ED मालमत्तेचा अनुसूचित गुन्ह्याशी संबंध दाखवू शकली नाही म्हणून जामीन मंजूर; राष्ट्रीय पातळीवरील घोटाळ्यांकडे लक्ष देण्याचे ED ला आवाहन.

items.caseName: Sujan v. State
items.headline: Default sentence cut for poor Bangladeshi migrants
items.text: Conviction upheld; default term cut from a month to a week as they can't pay the fine. Deport in 30 days.

hi.headline: गरीब बांग्लादेशी प्रवासियों की जुर्माना न भरने पर सज़ा घटी
hi.text: दोषसिद्धि बरकरार; जुर्माना न भर पाने के कारण बदले की सज़ा एक महीने से घटाकर एक सप्ताह की गई। 30 दिन में निर्वासन।

mr.headline: गरीब बांगलादेशी स्थलांतरितांची दंड न भरल्याबद्दलची शिक्षा कमी
mr.text: दोषसिद्धी कायम; दंड भरू शकत नसल्याने पर्यायी शिक्षा एका महिन्यावरून एका आठवड्यावर आणली. 30 दिवसांत हद्दपारी.

items.caseName: State of Haryana v. Hem Raj
items.coram: Anoop Chitkara, Harmeet Singh Deol, JJ.
items.headline: Death row convict acquitted in 2018 child murder
items.text: Death sentence set aside; police ignored a Childline record naming another person.

hi.headline: 2018 के बाल हत्या मामले में मृत्युदंड पाए दोषी को बरी किया
hi.text: मृत्युदंड रद्द; पुलिस ने चाइल्डलाइन के उस रिकॉर्ड को नज़रअंदाज़ किया जिसमें किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति का नाम था।

mr.headline: 2018 च्या बालहत्या प्रकरणात फाशीची शिक्षा झालेला दोषी निर्दोष मुक्त
mr.text: फाशीची शिक्षा रद्द; दुसऱ्या व्यक्तीचे नाव असलेल्या चाइल्डलाइनच्या नोंदीकडे पोलिसांनी दुर्लक्ष केले.

items.caseName: Priyank M. Kharge v. Tejas A. & Anr.
items.headline: RSS defamation case against Priyank Kharge stayed
items.text: Proceedings stayed as the Magistrate didn't test if the complainant was 'aggrieved'; notice issued, records called.

hi.headline: प्रियांक खड़गे के विरुद्ध RSS मानहानि मामले पर रोक
hi.text: कार्यवाही पर रोक, क्योंकि मजिस्ट्रेट ने यह नहीं जाँचा कि शिकायतकर्ता 'व्यथित' व्यक्ति है या नहीं; नोटिस जारी, अभिलेख मँगाए गए।

mr.headline: प्रियांक खरगे यांच्याविरुद्धच्या RSS बदनामी प्रकरणाला स्थगिती
mr.text: तक्रारदार 'पीडित' व्यक्ती आहे का, हे दंडाधिकाऱ्यांनी तपासले नाही म्हणून कार्यवाहीला स्थगिती; नोटीस जारी, नोंदी मागवल्या.

items.caseName: Gopal Pathak v. Nitin @ Pappu & Anr.
items.headline: Judges must compare disputed signatures themselves
items.text: Under Section 72 BSA courts must compare handwriting themselves; experts only when in doubt or writing is unclear.

items.caseName: P & Anr. v. State of West Bengal & Anr.
items.coram: N. Kotiswar Singh, N.V. Anjaria, JJ.
items.headline: Vague 498A charges against in-laws quashed
items.text: Case against the husband's parents quashed: the allegations were not specific, cogent or credible.

items.caseName: Chhaganbhai Kohyabhai Pateliya & Ors. v. State of Gujarat & Ors.
items.headline: Ex-daily wagers can't be denied post-regularisation increments
items.text: Regularised workers get the increment due after retirement; dues to be paid in 30 days, with 6% interest on delay.

items.caseName: Dr. M.K. Ravi Varma v. National Institute of Technology & Ors.
items.headline: Excess pay can be recovered from teachers who gave undertakings
items.text: NIT Calicut may recover Academic Grade Pay paid by mistake, as the teachers had undertaken to refund it.

items.caseName: Tapasmita Sutar v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Bench clerk work isn't law clerk experience
items.text: Bench clerk service can't count towards the practice needed for judicial service; plea rejected.

items.caseName: SVKM's Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies v. Bar Council of India
items.coram: Vikram Nath, Sandeep Mehta, Augustine George Masih, JJ.
items.headline: Law school attendance case: verdict reserved
items.text: Verdict reserved on the Delhi HC attendance ruling; para 249 stays stayed, with one-time exam protection for students.

items.caseName: N. Ravi v. Speaker, Legislative Assembly, Chennai
items.coram: 7-judge bench led by Surya Kant, CJI
items.headline: 23-year-old privilege vs free speech reference closed
items.text: Reference disposed of as infructuous since the 2003 TN Assembly resolution was withdrawn; questions left open.

items.caseName: Dheeraj Kumar v. Union of India & Anr.
items.coram: Vikram Nath, Sandeep Mehta, Augustine George Masih, JJ.
items.headline: No order for daily Preamble recitation in schools
items.text: PIL dismissed; the Court noted the Preamble is already taught in schools from Class 6.

items.caseName: A v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Uncertified Instagram chats can't prove adultery
items.text: Husband's revision against maintenance dismissed; chats without the statutory certificate aren't admissible.

items.caseName: Mallampudi Veera Venkata Krishna Reddy & Ors. v. Syamala Satyanarayana Reddy & Ors.
items.headline: Same-day sales to relatives are an act of insolvency
items.text: Debtor declared insolvent: sale deeds to relatives were made to defeat creditors; receiver to be appointed.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.headline: Husband may amend his counter after trial begins
items.text: Amendment allowed in a conjugal rights case to fix typing errors; courts shouldn't be hyper-technical.

items.caseName: Sajiduzzaman Mhammad Hanif Shahid v. Sagar Durgadas Rathod & Anr.
items.coram: Urmila Joshi Phalke, Raj D. Wakode, JJ.
items.headline: Lawyers convicted for threatening a judge in court
items.text: Ex-bar president and son guilty of contempt; fined, ₹50,000 costs each and referred to the Bar Council.

items.caseName: Joy Krishna Nag @ Joy Kumar Nag @ Rohit v. State of West Bengal & Ors.
items.headline: ₹5.36 lakh for 60 days' jail after bail
items.text: Custody after bail was 'not sanctioned by law'; State to pay ₹5.36 lakh within four weeks.

items.caseName: Ranjeet Kumar Ghosh v. State of West Bengal & Ors.
items.headline: Driver's wife may donate kidney to his employer
items.text: Refusal set aside as there was no sign of payment or a middleman; committee to reconsider in two weeks.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: FRO rapped for deciding citizenship during SIR appeal
items.text: Bilaspur FRO made a party for deciding citizenship while appeals were pending; report sought, listed 8 Oct.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: PepsiCo, Monster may sell existing 'energy drink' stock
items.text: No coercive action on FSSAI's label directions; old stock may be sold but none made. Next hearing 5 Nov.

items.caseName: J. Shivakumar v. Chairman, Karnataka State Bar Council & Anr.
items.headline: Bar Council can't reject enrolment for lack of a degree
items.text: It must refer equivalence to the BCI under Section 26(2); BCI to decide within 60 days.

items.caseName: Dr. K. Prem Anand v. Dr. Susan Isaac
items.headline: Husband already paying can't plead inability
items.text: Challenge to ₹1.1 lakh monthly interim maintenance dismissed with ₹2 lakh costs.

items.caseName: X v. Y
items.headline: Share-sale gains count as husband's income
items.text: Maintenance for wife and son raised from ₹50,000 to ₹1.2 lakh a month.

items.caseName: Aswathi G.R. v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.coram: Anil K. Narendran, Muralee Krishna S., JJ.
items.headline: BJP councillor's KAAPA detention quashed
items.text: R. Sugathan freed: the order was passed casually and illegible documents were supplied.

items.caseName: K v. I
items.coram: J. Nisha Banu, Shoba Annamma Eapen, JJ.
items.headline: Khula doesn't need the husband's consent
items.text: Family court need only check three conditions, not hold a detailed inquiry.

items.caseName: Udayan v. X & Ors.
items.headline: Hiding live-in partner and child is 'deceitful means'
items.text: Anticipatory bail refused under Section 69 BNS; accused told to surrender.

items.caseName: X v. State of Kerala
items.headline: Low IQ alone doesn't make an accused unfit for trial
items.text: Under Section 368 BNSS, an accused who can follow proceedings is fit for trial.

items.caseName: A v. D
items.headline: Disability no excuse to evade maintenance
items.text: Husband who married knowing his incapacity must pay ₹10,000 a month; he has the means.

items.caseName: Avtar Singh v. M/s Des Raj & Co.
items.headline: Section 311 CrPC can't fill gaps after evidence closes
items.text: Plea to reopen defence evidence in a cheque case rejected.

items.caseName: Amit Kumar v. State of Punjab & Ors.
items.headline: Biological father alone can't get habeas corpus
items.text: Custody plea dismissed as guardianship proceedings are pending before a competent court.

items.caseName: Rajiv Kashyap v. State of Uttarakhand
items.headline: Juvenility can be claimed at any stage
items.text: Murder conviction upheld but life term set aside, as he was 17 at the time.

items.court: Rouse Avenue Courts, New Delhi, Delhi
items.caseName: NCB v. Nympha
items.headline: Charas export bid convict; NCB lapse flagged
items.text: Filipino national convicted under NDPS for 560 g charas; court flagged NCB units' failure to cooperate.

items.caseName: Martanda Singh v. State of Chhattisgarh & Anr.
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Long consensual relationship isn't rape by false promise
items.text: Rape case quashed: a three-year consensual relationship doesn't show consent was obtained by a false promise of marriage.

items.caseName: Additional Commissioner, Commercial Tax v. Cadila Health Care Ltd.
items.headline: Tax goods by their form at sale, not end use
items.text: Powders and biscuits can't be taxed as beverages just because buyers may mix them with milk or water.

items.caseName: Rakesh Kumar Singh v. Union of India
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: No ex parte suspension of CEC; ECI must respond
items.text: Plea to suspend CEC Gyanesh Kumar refused for now; notice issued to the Centre and ECI on claims of unilateral decisions.

items.caseName: Union of India v. Meena Gupta & Ors.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Great Nicobar PILs to go on in Calcutta HC
items.text: Centre's challenge to PIL maintainability rejected; Calcutta HC to hear the petitions on 25–26 November.

items.caseName: Ashish Mishra @ Monu v. State of U.P.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Lakhimpur Kheri: trial judge report sent to HC Chief Justice
items.text: Vigilance report on the trial judge sent to the Allahabad HC Chief Justice; UP to appoint a new special prosecutor.

items.caseName: Association of Retired Judges of Supreme Court and High Courts of India v. NHRC & Ors.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Notice on vacant State Human Rights Commissions
items.text: Notice issued on a PIL to fill vacancies in State Human Rights Commissions within a fixed time.

items.caseName: In Re: Recent Rape Incidents in Delhi NCR
items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Safety audits ordered across Delhi-NCR
items.text: Police told to run safety audits, map high-risk zones and monitor CCTV live; compliance due by 16 November.

items.caseName: In Re: 135-Year-Old Library, 8.5 Lakh Books and No Room in the New Central Vista Plan
items.headline: Centre must show space for 135-year-old library
items.text: Centre to file an affidavit with layout plans for the library's new space; Haripriya Padmanabhan made amicus.

items.caseName: In Re: Fundamental Right to Walk and Footpath v. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
items.headline: Centre to name an authority for footpaths on every road
items.text: Centre to identify a funded authority to ensure footpaths, pick five pilot towns and report in three weeks.

items.caseName: State of Tamil Nadu v. Vignesh
items.headline: NDPS bail for unsupplied arrest grounds: order reserved
items.text: Verdict reserved on whether bail can follow failure to give arrest grounds even when Section 37 NDPS bars aren't met.

items.caseName: Rajpal Naurang Yadav & Anr. v. M/s Murli Projects Pvt. Ltd.
items.coram: Surya Kant, CJI; Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana, JJ.
items.headline: Actor Rajpal Yadav told to deposit ₹5 crore
items.text: Rebuked for not depositing ₹5 crore in cheque cases; told to pay by 6 Oct, matter listed first on 7 Oct.

items.caseName: Shanawaz Khan & 5 Ors. v. State of U.P. & 4 Ors.
items.headline: Don't stop five-time azan if noise rules are kept
items.text: Police told not to interfere with azan at a Saharanpur mosque if noise rules are followed, on an undertaking.

items.caseName: Moti Ram Jaat @ Moti Ram Jaat Fauji v. State of U.P. & Anr.
items.headline: Arrest in a second case is a fresh arrest
items.text: Grounds must be given under Art. 22(1) for a new case, but that plea can be raised only up to the remand stage.

items.caseName: Fanindra Das v. The General Manager & Anr.
items.headline: Railways can't refuse power citing private land
items.text: Where only the Railways can supply power, it must give the connection within 30 days; electricity is part of Art. 21.

items.caseName: National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Reeta & 4 Ors.
items.headline: Accident payout raised on insurer's own appeal
items.text: Once an insurer disputes the amount, the court must ensure just compensation, even without a cross-appeal.

items.caseName: Sagar Gawai & Anr. v. Election Commission of India & Ors.
items.coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, CJ; Advait Sethna, J.
items.headline: No stay on Maharashtra SIR voter deletions
items.text: Stay refused as the Supreme Court is hearing SIR challenges; matter deferred by three weeks.

items.caseName: Raj Kumar Jaiswal v. State of West Bengal & Anr.
items.headline: Obscene gesture and remark outraged modesty
items.text: Six-month jail under Section 509 IPC upheld; the woman's testimony was found credible.

items.caseName: Shaikh Mujtaba Farooq & Ors. v. Union of India & Ors.
items.headline: No independent probe into 2020 riots, Jamia violence
items.text: Pleas for an independent probe and FIRs against politicians dismissed; no material showed police compromised the probe.

items.caseName: ANI Media Pvt. Ltd. v. RSY News
items.headline: Copying whole news videos isn't fair dealing
items.text: Summary judgment for ANI: RSY News barred from using its videos and told to take down infringing content.

items.caseName: Imrat Singh v. Chimna
items.headline: Elderly men may rely on a younger woman for litigation
items.text: Refusal to condone delay set aside; assuming a woman can't handle family litigation was called gender-biased.

items.caseName: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam v. CTR Nirmal Kumar & Ors.
items.headline: DMK may sue TN ministers for defamation
items.text: Leave granted to sue over remarks in the Veeramani POCSO case; they were personal remarks, not official acts.

items.caseName: G v. A
items.headline: Woman misled about husband's divorce gets maintenance
items.text: Strict proof of marriage isn't needed under Section 125 CrPC where the couple lived together long-term.

items.caseName: V. Thangavel v. The Inspector of Police
items.headline: Make attachment mandatory in graft cases, says HC
items.text: Confiscation order set aside for want of attachment; the Court urged a law making attachment mandatory.

items.caseName: Tata Steel v. State Pollution Control Board
items.headline: Pollution case against Tata Steel quashed
items.text: Section 32A IBC shields Tata Steel from liability for Bhushan Steel's old management's acts.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, CJ; Rohit Kapoor, J.
items.headline: CBI to probe graft claims against CM's aide
items.text: CBI told to register a case on ED's referral against CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD; State must assist.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, CJ; Rohit Kapoor, J.
items.headline: Demolition against whistleblower lawyer goes to CBI
items.text: Demolition of a lawyer's farm stay soon after he flagged corruption showed apparent malice; CBI to probe.

items.caseName: Muslim Khan v. National Investigation Agency
items.coram: Sanjay K. Agrawal, CJ; Sameer Jain, J.
items.headline: No bail for five in Kanhaiya Lal murder case
items.text: UAPA bail appeals dismissed; the terror act was said to strike at the nation's 'psychological sovereignty'.

items.caseName: Mahesh Kumar Gupta & Ors. v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: Accused parents may fly abroad for son's surgery
items.text: Travel to the US allowed despite a pending probe; a parent's care isn't limited to hospitalisation.

items.caseName: S.Q. Masood & Anr. v. Election Commission of India & Ors.
items.coram: P. Sam Koshy, Narsing Rao Nandikonda, JJ.
items.headline: ECI must explain voter's exclusion without notice
items.text: ECI asked why a voter was dropped in the AI-based SIR without notice; listed on 13 October.

items.court: Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, Delhi
items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.headline: Bail for 17 students, journalists after CEC protest
items.text: Bail on ₹15,000 bonds; the court noted they are young first-time accused, though the allegations were serious.

items.caseName: Prabha Devi v. State of Bihar & Ors.
items.coram: Satish Chandra Sharma, N.K. Singh, JJ.
items.headline: Not stopping a son isn't cruelty by mother-in-law
items.text: Case against a mother-in-law quashed; vague claims of taunts or failing to restrain her son don't make out Section 498A.

items.caseName: Case title not yet reported
items.coram: P.V. Sanjay Kumar, Sanjeev Sachdeva, JJ.
items.headline: Suo motu case on moving 135-year-old library
items.text: SC took up on its own the plan to shift the Central Secretariat Library's 8.5 lakh volumes into two rooms; listed for 5 Oct.

items.caseName: Pooja Devi v. State of U.P. and 3 Others
items.coram: Ajay Bhanot, Divesh Chandra Samant, JJ.
items.headline: DM must refer Gangsters Act property plea to court
items.text: A DM who rejects a plea to release attached property must refer it to court under Section 16(1); the order was quashed.

items.caseName: X v. State of Andhra Pradesh & Others
items.headline: No trial of NRI in-laws without Centre's sanction
items.text: Cruelty case against NRI relatives quashed: acts abroad needed Section 188 CrPC sanction and Indian allegations were vague.

items.caseName: X v. State & Anr.
items.headline: Retaliatory 498A case against husband quashed
items.text: No specific overt acts were alleged, and the complaint followed her kin's conviction for assaulting the husband's family.

items.caseName: B Vijaya Sai v. State of Andhra Pradesh & Another
items.headline: NBWs need reasons, not routine issue
items.text: Non-bailable warrant against a 70-year-old in a cheque case recalled; courts must record reasons before coercive steps.

items.caseName: Harbinder Singh Kalsi & Anr. v. State of Assam & Ors.
items.coram: Ashutosh Kumar, CJ; Arun Dev Choudhury, J.
items.headline: Lawyers aren't guarantors of a client's whereabouts
items.text: Costs of ₹50,000 and a Bar Council referral against advocates set aside; they must still verify a vakalatnama is genuine.

items.caseName: Sanjay Badaya v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: Bail in Jal Jeevan Mission forgery case: undertrial custody is not punishment
items.text: Probe over and chargesheets filed, two accused in the Rs 979 crore PHED contracts case got bail. Pre-trial jail can't act as punishment.
items.why: Reinforces that bail cannot be denied to punish an accused before trial.

items.caseName: Arjun Gopal v. Union of India
items.coram: M.M. Sundresh, Augustine George Masih, JJ.
items.headline: No total firecracker ban, no round-the-clock bursting
items.text: The Court ruled out both extremes and accepted joint crackers with limits. Barium testing of green crackers must finish by 15 October.

items.caseName: Mahendra Singh Deo v. Govind Mohan
items.headline: Special Bench faults Registry over CAPF contempt delisting

items.caseName: Veena Rani Saluja v. State of U.P.
items.headline: UP police officer summoned over 'unknown accused' FIR
items.text: The FIR named no accused though the rider was caught on the spot. The Circle Officer must appear and explain at the next hearing.

items.coram: J.B. Pardiwala, K. Vinod Chandran, JJ.
items.headline: Can IPC case go on after PC Act sanction is refused?

items.caseName: Raghvendra Dubey v. State of U.P.
items.headline: CCTV down? Police must log every arrest in the General Diary
items.text: Finding about 24 hours of illegal detention, the Court awarded Rs 10,000 and said missing footage can lead to an adverse inference.

items.text: The special court's bail order in the Antilia bomb scare case was stayed. The NIA's appeal will be heard in the first week of October.

items.coram: Prathiba M. Singh, Dinesh Bhatt, JJ.
items.headline: Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam denied bail in riots UAPA case
